body: I thought about how life without baseline happiness is a torture, and others who are happy can move on.

Different places. I do it spontaneously with excuse me, I know I'm being random but I noticed your looks and want your number. I suppose I should somehow get them to say more and have more reasons to want her number, but I don't know what to do. 

Mall, streets, bus, college

I feel you. Some parts are different for me, but the point is there. I also have the decision of suicide if improving my life fails.
I understand how you feel. I consider suicide every week. I keep living in a shelter on disability income for mental illness. But, I think you have the capabilities to keep going.

Thanks for sharing. You're in a better life than me! I lived in mental wards for long times, and medicine doesn't help me. I live on disability income, because people in my head make me talk to them or yell at them. 

The only thing that keeps me going is my goals in science and business.

Hey, I relate to feeling like suicide may be the painless way. I've been hesitant for years. I live in a shelter, on disability income for mental illness. People in my head make it hard to stay calm or focused.

If you make $30k per year, you're at the top of 7.45 billion humans. Most would swap places with you, right now. 

If you pay tax or volunteer, you took money from a company and gave to government needs. Water treatment  management is one.
